title: Bought ranch as skeptic intending to donate to Boy Scouts

tellings.quote: claims and I actually intended to to donate it to the Boy Scouts of America

plain: The current owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long tied to reports of UFOs and strange events, says he bought it around 2016 as a skeptic of those claims. He tells Michels he "actually intended to donate it to the Boy Scouts of America." His point is that he did not come to the ranch expecting anything unusual.
